Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer # **Details** ### 1) 2D Pattern Viewer * On the Content page, click the '2D' thumbnail button to begin. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778378410521) *Compatible with ZPRJ/ZPAC files uploaded from Dec 3rd, 2024. Please re-upload older files. * By default, the 2D Viewer will match what is displayed in CLO3D software when the '2D > Point of Measure > Edit Point of Measure' option is turned off & Pattern Outlines unlocked. * All information display fields are turned off by default. | ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 at 1.43.46 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778393746713) | ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 at 1.43.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778412342937) ---|---|--- ### 2) Show/Hide Toolbar * On the 2D Viewer, find the display toolbar to control the view * Selective menus available at the moment. More to be released in near future. | ![Screenshot 2024-11-12 at 11.52.21 AM 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778394131097) | ![Screenshot 2024-11-12 at 11.52.34 AM 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778412819737) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48447790221465) ---|---|---|--- * * **Garment Display**(default: off) * Show Baseline * **Information Display**(default: all off) * Show pattern name * Show line length (displayed in mm only) * Show angle * Show grainline * Show 2D measurements (displayed in mm only) * **Garment Rendering Style** * Front Textured Surface - Default * Monochrome Surface * Translucent Surface * Transparent Surface * Mesh * For more details on each menu, visit the **CLO3D** article on **[2D Window Display Icons](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/360011148874-2D-Window-Display-Icons)** ### 3) Mouse Navigation (Zoom/Panning) * **Zoom** : Scroll up & down to zoom in & out * **Panning** : 2 options available 1. Wheel Click + Move Mouse 2. Alt (Option) + Left Mouse Button + Move Mouse ### ### 4) Annotation on 2D Viewer * You can create [Annotations](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219363481) on the 2D Viewer to communicate with your team ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778413245337) 1. **Thumbnail** : Once Annotations are created, a blue label icon will be displayed on the Thumbnail & Version 2. **Annotation** : Find the Annotations 3. **Annotation Tab** : On the right pane of the screen, click on the Annotation button at the top to view the full list of Annotations created on the Content. Please note that the numbering will be shared between viewer types. That is, Annotations will be numbered in order of creation, regardless of the viewer type (3D or 2D). ### 5) Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin * 2D Pattern Viewer is activated by default for .zprj/.zpac files * To **deactivate** the 2D Pattern Viewer, visit [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page > General > Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778395115161). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778395407513)

title: Search
content: # **Objective** Find your Contents with the search feature in CLO-SET. Find it fast. Find it easy. 1. [Search Tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/undefined#h_01H570RFSHKRKYPQ938B1SVKTB) 2. Keyword Search 3. Image Search 4. Filters 5. View / Sort Option 6. Workroom/Assortment Search # **Details** ### 1) Search Tab * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776088187161) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.17.22 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776097100057) ---|--- 1. 1. Keyword search 2. Image search 3. Reset search options 4. Filter search results 5. View/Sort option ### 2) Text Search ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776112246297) Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID. Please note that only the Contents to which you have access to will be displayed as the search result. ### 3) Image Search ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.08 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114269721) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.56.38 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776128898969) ---|--- To start searching with image files, click on 'search by image' icon next to the magnifier icon. Upload an image file, and click 'Apply'. CLO-SET AI will detect the shape, color, and pattern and find similar Contents. * Start searching with image files such as: * Rendered output of your Content * Physical image of the design * Pattern images used for the Content ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776114562073) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776145656985) ---|---|--- ### 4) Filters ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098255769) Use Search filters to expand or narrow down the search results. Learn what each of the filters indicate: * [Content Type](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801): Each Content is classified as a single Content Type. You may select the Content Type at the time of upload, or CLO-SET will auto-assign one based on your file format. * [Space](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865): Select a Company, Brand, or Workroom Space to conduct the search. Click on the ► icon view lower-level Spaces. Once the selection is made, click 'Next'. * User must have 'Viewer' or above permission to select the respective Space. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241) / [Category](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049): Can only be applied once the Space selection is made. ### 5) View/Sort Option ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.27.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776115130649) --- Modify viewing and sorting options: * View By: * Contents: Search results will show each Content only * Colorway: Search results will show each Colorway of the Content * Sort By: * Last Modified * Name: Sorting based on the file name. * [Workflow](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241): Sorting based on the Workflow steps identified from your Company Settings * Relevance : Sorts results based on how closely they match the search keyword or image ### 6) Workroom/Assortment Search Users can search for a specific Workroom or Assortment by its name. Select the 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' option from the 'Search For' drop down next to the search bar. #### **1\. In Company, Brand, Line, Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146241433) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed * Hover over the Workroom to view the location path ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776098799129) #### **2\. In Season** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' or 'Assortment' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776146620441) * Type in the keyword to search for Workroom/Assortment. Search results display Workroom/Assortment with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within the selected Season * Please note that the search results will **only** display either Workrooms or Assortments per your selection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776157509913) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116190233) ---|--- #### **3\. In Workroom** * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select 'Workroom' * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword to search for Child Workrooms. Search results display all Child Workrooms with names that includes your input (Do not support placeholders) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776116413465)
content_description: "Effortlessly locate your content in CLO-SET with our intuitive search features, including keyword and image searches, filters, and sorting options."

title: Custom View
content:
## **Objective** Understand how to use the custom view feature on CLO-SET. 1. What is Custom View? 2. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard 3. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Content page 4. Selecting Custom view option on CLO Software ## **Details** #### **1) What is Custom View?** Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. Link to [Custom View](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004420828-Custom-View) CLO3D. In CLO-SET, now we support thumbnail image and turntable images based on the Custom View. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only saved
> > for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including **Linesheet** ,
> > **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnail images in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47460161161369) #### **2) Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard** In the Space and Dashboard areas of CLO-SET, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" option when uploading a file. ![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47482755327129) #### **3)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Content page** 1. 'Custom View' option is also available on the Content page of CLO-SET. By selecting Version Update on the Content page and choosing a single file, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option.![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698939673) 2. By selecting 'Create New Version' on the Colorway tab, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option.![Body1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698940825) #### **4)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO Software** 1. When directly uploading from CLO software to CLO-SET, you can also use the Custom View function. By clicking the CLO-SET tab at the top, you can select either "Upload to CLO-SET" or "Render via CLO-SET." At this point, on the CLO-SET screen that appears, you can activate the function by clicking "Use Custom View as Thumbnail" toggle. * If the file does not have a custom view, this toggle will not be activated. ![Body2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108621977) 2. In the CLO software, you can access User Settings to configure options related to version updates. Here, you can enable the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function, which allows you to apply the custom view feature when working on a file imported from the CLO-SET library and performing an immediate version update. This operates independently of the Custom View Thumbnail function on the Direct Upload (Share via CLO-SET) described earlier. ![Body3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108625945)
content_description: Explore the Custom View feature on CLO-SET to enhance your design presentations by learning how to apply and utilize this function across various platform areas.

title: Global Unit Setting (Measurement & Currency)
content: ## **Objective** Understand Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) Setting. 1. What is Global Unit Setting 2. Managing global unit inconsistencies 3. Default Currency in Web Tech Pack / Content Page / Linesheet ## ## **Details** #### **1) What is Global Unit Setting?** Global Unit setting is an unified management of currency & measurement units at the company level. In Company Settings, you can configure the Global Unit (Measurement & Currency), and it currently applies to the 2D Pattern Viewer and is synchronized with the Content Custom Field (Length) and Web Tech Pack (BOM, POM, and Cost Estimation tabs). ![ddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47495014053529) > 💡 **Note:** Global Unit Setting is applied at the company level > 💡 **Note:** User with **'Company Admin'** or '**Group Admin'** permission can modify these options. #### **2) Managing Global Unit Inconsistency** If the unit set in Company Settings differs from the unit of the file, a Modal will appear, indicating which unit is different. This modal is displayed in the following four cases: 1\. Mismatch when versioning up file![dddddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502634508057) 2\. Mismatch when uploading file ![GGGG.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502666844569) 3\. Mismatch when updating tech pack version ![ㅁㄴㅇ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502666846361) 4\. Mismatch when adding BOM item to the table ![ㅂㅈㄷㄱ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47502634511257) #### #### **3) Unit Synchronization** Unit set in Company Settings is synchronized across various domains in CLO-SET. In the Web Tech Pack, the Global Unit is synchronized and displayed in the **"Overview"** , "**BOM"** and **"Cost Estimation"** tabs. 1\. Web Tech Pack Unit Synchronization Measurement Unit and Price Unit data are synchronized and displayed, with the price unit shown as the **"default currency"** in the top right corner. ![111.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362877721) If the price unit differs, both the **"default currency"** and the **"file currency"** are displayed simultaneously in the top right corner. ![222.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362878233) ![17.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878308633) 2\. The default currency is also displayed on the 'Content Page' and the 'Linesheet'. ![ㅁㅇㄹㅇㅁㄴㄹ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519868822297)![ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878310809)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of Global Unit Setting, including its definition, management of inconsistencies, and synchronization across various platforms within the CLO-SET system.

title: Web Tech Pack ▶ BOM
content:
#### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778373046681) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388098457) Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388301081) Editor # **Objective** ![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388458265) | CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- On the BOM tab, you can add/edit subsidiary materials and estimated cost critical for production. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 11.24.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778373826201) 1. Colorway/Grade/Version 2. Edit Material Detail 3. Add Material Item 4. Add/Delete Row 5. Version Update # # **Details** ### 1)Colorway/Grade/Version ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 11.30.12 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778388740121) You may view the BOM data per Colorway, Grade, and Content Version * **Colorway** \- You may create new Colorway from CLO/MD software * **Grade** \- You may create new Grades in CLO3D software * **Version** \- When you upload a new version of the Content on CLO-SET, you can choose to update WTP information accordingly. * **[Important]** Information is managed and updated per **Colorway-Grade** combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. ### 2) Edit Material Detail ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.19.28 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374092313) * Non-Editable: Content ID (if uploaded on CLO-SET) / Name / Color / Texture / Marker are extracted from your zprj/zpac file. * Editable: Consumption / Unit Price / Total Price / Remark can be edited on WTP. This information will also be reflected on WTP - Cost Estimation tab * Material information may be added/edited/deleted per Colorway/Grading/Version per your selection. ### ### 3) Add Material Item ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.55.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374312601) **1\. Add Blank Row : Text-based Item** When you click on the **Add 1 blank row** , a new blank row is created. * * The **Name** can be edited. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.02.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328857625) * * The **Color** can be picked. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.06 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328860825) * * The **Texture** and **Marker** images can be uploaded. ** ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 1.03.19 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263305690777) ** **2\. Add Content Row : Item from CLO-SET ** When you click on the **Add 1 content row** , a **Add Trim** pop-up is shown. You may browse through your Tree Menu or find Recent Trim files from your CLO-SET Group. ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 1.57.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374487705) * Contents added directly from CLO-SET will be marked with a blue 'CLO-SET' icon next to the 'Name' as shown below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374664089) * Please note that the Content Type must match the type of material you want to add. For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric[ Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. * User must have 'Editor' or above [permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. * When adding a material from CLO-SET, it will load the latest version that matches the file format. * Version updates on the Trim files will NOT be reflected to the WTP automatically. If needed, please delete the old material and add it again. * If the Trim file is deleted in CLO-SET, the BOM table will mark the material as 'deleted'. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. You can not change/edit the Type after the upload. **WTP Section / Subsection** | **Content Type** | **File Format** ---|---|--- Fabric | Fabric | zfab Trim / Graphic | Graphic | jpg, jpeg, gif, png, bmp, raw, psd, ai, tif, tiff, svg Trim / Button Head | Button Head | btn Trim / Button Hole | Button Hole | bth Trim / Zipper | Zipper | zpl, zpu, zsd, zsl, zst, zss, zsp Trim / Thread | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Top Stitch | Top Stitch / Thread | sst Trim / Others | Etc | trm ### 4) Add/Delete Row ![Screenshot 2023-07-31 at 2.01.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778374843673) You may delete/add rows on the BOM table. Right-click on the Row to either delete it or add new above/below the selected row. ![Screenshot 2025-04-15 at 12.58.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46263328862361) To change the order of the rows, you may drag the No column cell and move around to adjust the ordering. ### 5) WTP Version Update
``` ![merge_modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778375028761) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778390207897)
``` * When you upload a [new version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP * If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a[ Style Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), * New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. * Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. * If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. * What does an 'update' mean in Web Tech Pack? * If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM * If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack * If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. * Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically * Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version * Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide comprehensive guidance on utilizing the CLO-SET Web Tech Pack to seamlessly integrate and manage 3D content, materials, and cost details for efficient tech pack creation and updates.

title: Workflow & Status
content: # **Objective** Mark & Share the Workflow & Status of each Content/Colorway for effective collaboration. 1. Workflow vs. Status 2. Company Setting 3. Filter using Workflow 4. Workflow & Status in Line Sheet # **Details** ### 1) Workflow vs. Status ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778183162649) **Workflow** | **Status** ---|--- * * * * * * * * Can create custom names in Company Settings * Available to be edited by Admin / Collaborator / Editor * Synced with Line Sheet * For each Content * Can be used as a search filter | * For each Colorway within the Content ### 2) Company Setting Workflow and Status names can be managed in Company Setting. Please note that this can only be done by **Company Admin** and above. title: Strain Map on 3D Viewer
content: Compatible with Contents uploaded post **December 6th, 2023** # **Objectives** With this update, you can view the garment Strain map as done in CLO3D. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778306948761) 1. [Strain Map in Content Page](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8836806617743#h_01HMG2EH4GKF6QEJX9KNCNZ4ZJ) * [Compatibility](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8836806617743#h_01HMG38R51FS6T7KXKTFERVYD6) 2. [What is Strain Map?](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8836806617743#h_01HMG2ZGCFA0JC92QQ0WCG6D35) # **Details** ### 1) Strain Map in Content Page In the Content Page, click the 'Strain Map' icon, or use shortcut key (alt/option⌥ + 7) Once Strain Map is activated, you can find the Tightness Range bar on the top right. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307095065) #### **[Strain Map Compatibility]** * Content must have been uploaded after **December 6th, 2023**. If you see below error message, please re-upload the file to view Strain Map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307250457) * Strain Map is only applied to garments, not avatars. * Strain Map is **NOT** compatible with: * Garment Rendering Style Group * Schematic Render * Render * Configurator * Filter ### 2) What is Strain Map? ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307394329) Strain Map displays the distortion rate from 2D patterns to 3D patterns. This view is the same as CLO3D's ['Strain Map'](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/115012227287-Strain-Map) view in 'Monochrome' mode. * (3D pattern size / 2D Pattern size * 100)% Blue: 100% distortion, which means no distortion keeping the original pattern stretch Red: 120% distortion. The higher the rate is, the more distortion there are between 2D & 3D patterns. You may adjust the pattern placement/size based on the Strain Map data.
content_description: This web page provides an overview of the new Strain Map feature compatible with garments uploaded after December 6th, 2023, enabling users to visualize distortion rates between 2D and 3D patterns in CLO3D.

title: Plan Restrictions (Measurement Standard)
content: # **Objective** Understand plan limits and how the usage fields are calculated in CLO-SET. Your Group may have limited availability on selective features. Check[ CLO-SET Pricing Page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) for more details. 1. User 2. Company & Workroom 3. File Upload 4. Rendering 5. Embed View 6. CLO-SET API 7. Usage History 8. Plan Limit Error & Upgrade # **Details** Based on your Group's usage, you may need to upgrade your plan or pay additional charges. Visit **[CLO-SET Pricing page](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing)** to find the full list of plan types and feature availability. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.31.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456838666137) ### ### 1) User * Free Plan: invite/share with up to 3 users * Standard/Premium Plan: invite/share unlimited number of users. Charges apply per the number of users in the Group. * Users with Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer permission to any Space within the Group will be counted towards billing. Group Operators are not included. * Review the full list of users in the Group on [Console - Settings - Permission Management](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209418649). * If CLO employees are invited to your Group for support, they are excluded from the user count. ### 2) Company & Workroom * Free Plan: create up to 1 Company and 1 Workroom * Standard Plan: create up to 1 Company and 10 Workrooms * Premium Plan: unlimited Space creation * All Companies and [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) within the Group are counted, even if there is no Content uploaded within the Space. * On CLO-SET dashboard, click 'Workspace' button from the left pane. Click 'All Companies' or 'All Workrooms' to view the full list, and make changes if needed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778415314329) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778431143577) ### 3) File Upload * Free Plan: up to 10 files uploads per month. Renewed on the 1st of each month. * Standard/Premium Plan: unlimited file uploads and storage. * All file uploads, including version uploads and deleted files, are counted. * 'Sample.zprj' file created as a default is excluded from the count. * Visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257) to review the file upload usage for each measurement period. ### 4) [Rendering](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225) * Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size. For Rendering details, visit 'Workspace - Rendering' or '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' * Free Plan * up to 50MB per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade your plan to use more Rendering. * Premium & Standard Plan * up to 3 GB (Premium) or 1 GB (Standard) per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$10 per 1 GB** will be billed on the group’s next payment. * When you add a user to the group during your subscription, we’ll adjust the usage based on the remaining days and provide a proportional amount. ### 5) [Embed Viewer](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195817497) * The Embed Viewer count is based on the number of times end users open the Embed Viewer created from the content within your group. This includes all direct visits via the URL/QR code and access through the 3D Viewer URL embedded in your [Visual Board](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303200610841). * Visit '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' to view the current status. * Add-on purchase option is not available for Embed Viewer usage. Please**upgrade or add users** to the Group to allow more view counts. * Free Plan * up to 30 views per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Standard Plan * up to 100 views per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. You must upgrade for additional usage. * Premium Plan * up to 300 views per user in the Group each month. ### 6) [CLO-SET API ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303242212505) * CLO-SET API is available under the Premium plan or Enterprise plan only. * All API calls made for your Group will be counted, except the oAuth option. * Premium Plan * up to 300 API Calls per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. * Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. **$5 per 300 calls** will be billed on the group’s next payment. ### 7) Usage History To review your Group's feature usage, please visit [Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257). ### 8) Plan Limit Error & Upgrade * If your group exceeds the plan limit, you'll see an error message prompting an upgrade. * Group Admin & Group Operators * Visit [Console > Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) and click 'Change Plan' to upgrade the plan * All other permission * You will not be able to upgrade the Group's plan. Please contact your Group Admin. ![Screenshot 2025-05-28 at 5.35.08 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47456812712729) ---
content_description: This webpage aims to provide users with a comprehensive understanding of plan limits and usage calculations in CLO-SET, including guidance on upgrading plans and managing feature availability.

Change Company name 2. Space Settings: * [Company Library](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191826841) \- a unique Workroom where you can store commonly used Assets throughout the Company * [Line](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) \- an optional space level, between Brand & Season 3. Change logo color or profile picture for the Company 8. Manage Brands, Line, and Season within the Company ### 2) Category / Content - Workflow Category and Workflow are customizable fields, used to identify/search/filter the Content. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387263641) | | ![Workflow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387343897) ---|---|--- * **Category** : can add custom Category up to 4th depth * **Workflow** : can add custom Workflow stage, change name and color chips * Utilizing Category & Workflow * Identify the status of each Content * Filter or Search the Content using Category & Workflow * Quickly view the workflow status from Workroom ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776411956633) --- ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776412153881) ### 3) Content - Information ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776380481945) * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776380644377) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\.
